mainEntity.name: Should I focus on SEO or paid advertising for my remodeling company's website?

acceptedAnswer.text: Both SEO (Search Engine Optimization) and paid advertising (PPC) can be effective for a remodeling company's website, and often work best when used together. SEO focuses on organic, long-term visibility and sustained traffic by earning higher search rankings. Paid advertising provides immediate visibility and targeted traffic, allowing you to quickly reach specific audiences or promote special offers. The choice depends on your budget, immediate lead generation needs, and long-term growth strategy. A balanced approach often yields the best results, leveraging PPC for quick wins and SEO for sustainable growth.
acceptedAnswer.description: For a remodeling company, both SEO and paid advertising are valuable. SEO provides long-term organic visibility, while paid advertising offers immediate, targeted traffic. A combined strategy is often most effective.
